spellbook_magic_missile.name: Spellbook of Magic Missile
spellbook_magic_missile.lore: The first spell every apprentice masters. An unerring dart of pure magical force.

spellbook_sleep.name: Spellbook of Sleep
spellbook_sleep.lore: A gentle enchantment that sends living creatures into sudden slumber.

spellbook_light.name: Spellbook of Light
spellbook_light.lore: Banishes shadows. Simple, essential, and often the spell that saves lives.

spellbook_shield.name: Spellbook of Magic Shield
spellbook_shield.lore: A shimmering barrier that halves physical blows and improves your defenses.

spellbook_fire_bolt.name: Spellbook of Fire Bolt
spellbook_fire_bolt.lore: A bolt of concentrated flame. Dangerous to fire-resistant creatures, devastating to the rest.

spellbook_haste.name: Spellbook of Haste
spellbook_haste.lore: Accelerates your body to superhuman speed, granting a free second action each turn.

spellbook_heal.name: Spellbook of Heal
spellbook_heal.lore: Channels restorative energy. The deeper the mastery, the more HP recovered.

spellbook_invisibility.name: Spellbook of Invisibility
spellbook_invisibility.lore: Bends light around you. Invisibility is not invulnerability, but it is close.

spellbook_confusion.name: Spellbook of Confusion
spellbook_confusion.lore: Scrambles a monster's senses. A confused enemy attacks randomly and loses coordination.

spellbook_displacement.name: Spellbook of Displacement
spellbook_displacement.lore: Projects a false image of you, causing attackers to strike at empty air 30% of the time.

spellbook_ice_storm.name: Spellbook of Ice Storm
spellbook_ice_storm.lore: Freezing shards blast every visible monster. A battlefield-clearing spell.

spellbook_paralyze.name: Spellbook of Paralysis
spellbook_paralyze.lore: Locks a monster in magical stasis. Even the most fearsome creatures cannot move while paralyzed.

necronomicon.name: The Necronomicon
necronomicon.unidentified_name: a book bound in human flesh
necronomicon.lore: Naturom Demonto â€” roughly translated, the Book of the Dead. Bound in human flesh and inked in blood, this ancient Sumerian text contains funeral incantations, demon resurrection passages, and prophecies. It is NOT to be read aloud. Seriously. Don't.

mastery_blessing.desc: Army of Darkness costs 3 fewer MP to cast.

spellbook_cleanse.name: Spellbook of Cleanse
spellbook_cleanse.lore: A healer's primer on purification magic. The spells within were developed by temple physicians who needed to cure plague victims without touching them. One incantation removes any single affliction â€” poison, paralysis, disease, curse. Simple, reliable, life-saving.

spellbook_empower.name: Spellbook of Empower
spellbook_empower.lore: A war-mage's secret: channel arcane energy into a physical weapon for a single devastating strike. The technique was perfected by the battlemages of Carthage, who could shatter siege gates with an empowered hammer blow. Cast it, then strike â€” the next melee attack deals triple damage.

spellbook_smite.name: Spellbook of Smite
spellbook_smite.lore: The word of divine judgment, written in letters of fire. This spell calls down holy wrath upon a single target, bypassing all mortal resistances. It was said to be the weapon of archangels against demons â€” pure righteous force that recognizes no shield, no armor, no magical ward.

spellbook_summon_guardian.name: Spellbook of Summon Guardian
spellbook_summon_guardian.lore: Druids of the ancient groves could call spirit-beasts from the aether to fight alongside them. The guardian manifests for a brief time â€” drawn from the essence of creatures the caster has encountered. It fights, it protects, and then it fades. But in those precious moments, you are not alone.

spellbook_meteor.name: Spellbook of Meteor
spellbook_meteor.lore: The most destructive evocation known to mortal spellcraft. A fragment of a dying star is summoned from the void and hurled into the material plane. Everything in sight burns. The original text was recovered from the Library of Alexandria â€” one of the few scrolls to survive the fire, ironically.

spellbook_time_freeze.name: Spellbook of Time Freeze
spellbook_time_freeze.lore: To freeze time itself â€” this is the ambition that drove the greatest chronomancers to madness. The spell does not stop time; it suspends causality for all beings except the caster. For five heartbeats, nothing moves, nothing thinks, nothing acts. Use it to flee, to heal, to strike. It is the ultimate emergency â€” and finding this book may be the rarest stroke of fortune in your entire journey.

spellbook_fireball.name: Spellbook of Fireball
spellbook_fireball.lore: The quintessential battle mage's spell. A rolling sphere of flame engulfs everything in sight.
spellbook_fireball.sprite_desc: A leather-bound spellbook with flame motifs and glowing orange runes on a charred cover

spellbook_slow.name: Spellbook of Slow Monster
spellbook_slow.lore: Temporal magic that saps the speed from a creature, leaving it sluggish and vulnerable.
spellbook_slow.sprite_desc: A slate-blue spellbook with a stylized hourglass embossed in silver on the cover

spellbook_knock.name: Spellbook of Knock
spellbook_knock.lore: A locksmith's nightmare. This spell opens any mundane lock with a burst of arcane force.
spellbook_knock.sprite_desc: A brass-bound spellbook with a skeleton key motif on the cover and glowing keyhole symbol

spellbook_teleport_away.name: Spellbook of Teleport Away
spellbook_teleport_away.lore: Spatial magic that hurls a creature to a random location on the level. Or yourself, if you prefer.
spellbook_teleport_away.sprite_desc: A violet spellbook with swirling portal imagery and silver spatial runes on the cover

spellbook_acid_arrow.name: Spellbook of Acid Arrow
spellbook_acid_arrow.lore: An arrow of pure acid that burns on impact and continues to corrode flesh over time.
spellbook_acid_arrow.sprite_desc: A green-tinged spellbook with acid-etched designs and bubbling liquid trapped in the cover

spellbook_drain_life.name: Spellbook of Drain Life
spellbook_drain_life.lore: Vampiric magic that tears life force from a creature and channels it into the caster.
spellbook_drain_life.sprite_desc: A dark crimson spellbook with veins of red light pulsing across its leather binding

spellbook_fear.name: Spellbook of Fear
spellbook_fear.lore: Projects raw terror into a creature's mind, sending it fleeing in panic.
spellbook_fear.sprite_desc: A shadowy purple spellbook with a screaming face embossed in tarnished silver on the cover

spellbook_detect.name: Spellbook of Detect Monsters
spellbook_detect.lore: Expands the caster's awareness to sense every living creature on the level.
spellbook_detect.sprite_desc: A teal spellbook with an open eye symbol radiating concentric circles on the cover

spellbook_polymorph.name: Spellbook of Polymorph
spellbook_polymorph.lore: Warps reality around a creature, transforming it into something else entirely. Results vary.
spellbook_polymorph.sprite_desc: An iridescent spellbook whose cover shifts between animal shapes when viewed from different angles

spellbook_reflect.name: Spellbook of Reflect
spellbook_reflect.lore: Creates a shimmering aura that bounces hostile magic and status effects back at their source.
spellbook_reflect.sprite_desc: A silver-white spellbook with a polished mirror fragment set into the center of its cover

spellbook_disintegrate.name: Spellbook of Disintegrate
spellbook_disintegrate.lore: The ultimate destruction spell. Reduces a creature to dust with a single word of power.
spellbook_disintegrate.sprite_desc: A black obsidian spellbook with cracks of molten red light and ash drifting from its pages

sefer_yetzirah.name: Sefer Yetzirah (The Book of Formation)
sefer_yetzirah.lore: The Book of Formation. Attributed to Abraham; the oldest extant Jewish mystical text. It teaches the twenty-two letters of the Hebrew alphabet and the ten sefirot, and how the world was spoken into being. The Maharal of Prague used a copy in the sixteenth century to shape a golem of clay; the golem walked the streets of the Jewish quarter until the Maharal removed the Name from its forehead.

mastery_blessing.desc: The Sefer Yetzirah teaches the twenty-two letters that spoke the world into being — its spell costs 2 fewer MP.

picatrix.name: Picatrix
picatrix.lore: Picatrix — Ghayat al-Hakim, the Aim of the Sage. Composed in tenth-century al-Andalus, translated to Latin under Alfonso X, and read across Europe for the next four centuries. It teaches talismanic magic, planetary hours, and how to summon fire by naming a planet's degree of ascension. Dee owned a copy. Ficino read it carefully and pretended he hadn't.

mastery_blessing.desc: Picatrix systematised four centuries of talismanic magic — its spell costs 2 fewer MP.

lemegeton.name: Lemegeton (The Lesser Key of Solomon)
lemegeton.unidentified_name: a black tome sealed with sigils
lemegeton.lore: The Lemegeton. Five books bound as one; the first, the Ars Goetia, lists the seventy-two demons King Solomon bound to his service. Each demon has a sigil, a number of legions, and a particular use — Bael teaches invisibility, Asmodeus answers questions truthfully, Vassago finds lost things. Crowley translated it in 1904. Read it carefully.

mastery_blessing.desc: The Lemegeton names all seventy-two demons of Solomon — its spell costs 3 fewer MP.

spellbook_frost_touch.name: Spellbook of Frost Touch
spellbook_frost_touch.sprite_desc: A  tome bound in dark leather, the cover sigil glowing faintly.
spellbook_frost_touch.lore: Bound in seal-skin, the pages still cold to the touch decades after copying. The first ice-cantrip every Lapp shaman learned.

spellbook_cure_wounds.name: Spellbook of Cure Wounds
spellbook_cure_wounds.sprite_desc: A  tome bound in dark leather, the cover sigil glowing faintly.
spellbook_cure_wounds.lore: Field-medicine compendium from a battlefield priest. The pages are stained with what looks like wine but smells like older liquid.

spellbook_mage_armor.name: Spellbook of Mage Armor
spellbook_mage_armor.sprite_desc: A  tome bound in dark leather, the cover sigil glowing faintly.
spellbook_mage_armor.lore: Mage Armor: the most fundamental defensive cantrip. Every wizards' college copy is dog-eared at this page.

spellbook_detect_magic.name: Spellbook of Detect Magic
spellbook_detect_magic.sprite_desc: A  tome bound in dark leather, the cover sigil glowing faintly.
spellbook_detect_magic.lore: Dee's earliest divination tract — translation from the original Enochian, partial fragments only.

spellbook_blink.name: Spellbook of Blink
spellbook_blink.sprite_desc: A  tome bound in dark leather, the cover sigil glowing faintly.
spellbook_blink.lore: An apprentice's first teleportation primer. Includes a footnote warning against blinking over deep water.

spellbook_lightning_bolt.name: Spellbook of Lightning Bolt
spellbook_lightning_bolt.sprite_desc: A  tome bound in dark leather, the cover sigil glowing faintly.
spellbook_lightning_bolt.lore: Tesla's diary copy of the bolt-line incantation. Margin notes question whether the chalk was the resonator.

spellbook_mass_sleep.name: Spellbook of Mass Sleep
spellbook_mass_sleep.sprite_desc: A  tome bound in dark leather, the cover sigil glowing faintly.
spellbook_mass_sleep.lore: Lullaby of the Watchman of Antioch — read aloud, every sleeper in the room dreams of the same hill.

spellbook_detect_monsters_t2.name: Spellbook of Greater Detection
spellbook_detect_monsters_t2.sprite_desc: A  tome bound in dark leather, the cover sigil glowing faintly.
spellbook_detect_monsters_t2.lore: Detection cantrip transcribed from a Sufi divinatory manual. Each page bears a single eye in gold leaf.

spellbook_levitate.name: Spellbook of Levitation
spellbook_levitate.sprite_desc: A  tome bound in dark leather, the cover sigil glowing faintly.
spellbook_levitate.lore: St Joseph of Cupertino's confessional notes — the saint who could not stop floating. Several editions, all repudiated.

spellbook_cone_of_cold.name: Spellbook of Cone of Cold
spellbook_cone_of_cold.sprite_desc: A  tome bound in dark leather, the cover sigil glowing faintly.
spellbook_cone_of_cold.lore: Annals of Norilsk: thirty years of arctic-mage observations bound by the Soviet Academy and promptly classified.

spellbook_greater_heal.name: Spellbook of Greater Heal
spellbook_greater_heal.sprite_desc: A  tome bound in dark leather, the cover sigil glowing faintly.
spellbook_greater_heal.lore: Galen's Greater Healing — recovered from the Library of Alexandria fire by an apprentice who lost his arm carrying it out.

spellbook_stoneskin.name: Spellbook of Stoneskin
spellbook_stoneskin.sprite_desc: A  tome bound in dark leather, the cover sigil glowing faintly.
spellbook_stoneskin.lore: Dwarven Cantor's diary — describes the breath-technique that hardens the body to stone for one full breath cycle of seconds.

spellbook_counterspell.name: Spellbook of Counterspell
spellbook_counterspell.sprite_desc: A  tome bound in dark leather, the cover sigil glowing faintly.
spellbook_counterspell.lore: Mordenkainen's Argument — a single chapter on undoing another's working before it lands.

spellbook_dispel_magic.name: Spellbook of Dispel Magic
spellbook_dispel_magic.sprite_desc: A  tome bound in dark leather, the cover sigil glowing faintly.
spellbook_dispel_magic.lore: The Latin original of the rite — late-Renaissance, copied off a folio Dee burned but didn't burn well enough.

spellbook_mapping.name: Spellbook of Mapping
spellbook_mapping.sprite_desc: A  tome bound in dark leather, the cover sigil glowing faintly.
spellbook_mapping.lore: Geomancer's pocket-folio: ink lines that reveal themselves when held over candle smoke.

spellbook_chain_lightning_t4.name: Spellbook of Forked Lightning
spellbook_chain_lightning_t4.sprite_desc: A  tome bound in dark leather, the cover sigil glowing faintly.
spellbook_chain_lightning_t4.lore: Storm-singer's grimoire. Lightning forks one extra time for every rung of your chain — the arc-math is in the appendix.

spellbook_greater_invis.name: Spellbook of Greater Invisibility
spellbook_greater_invis.sprite_desc: A  tome bound in dark leather, the cover sigil glowing faintly.
spellbook_greater_invis.lore: Tarnhelm research notes from the Bayreuth Festival library — three Wagner-era scholars vanished while reading it.

spellbook_mass_paralyze.name: Spellbook of Mass Paralysis
spellbook_mass_paralyze.sprite_desc: A  tome bound in dark leather, the cover sigil glowing faintly.
spellbook_mass_paralyze.lore: Carpathian witch's recipe — paralysis was always her preferred technique, never the killing blow.

spellbook_banishment.name: Spellbook of Banishment
spellbook_banishment.sprite_desc: A  tome bound in dark leather, the cover sigil glowing faintly.
spellbook_banishment.lore: Solomon's binding-rite, distilled to the essentials. Useful only against what came from elsewhere.

spellbook_phase_door.name: Spellbook of Phase Door
spellbook_phase_door.sprite_desc: A  tome bound in dark leather, the cover sigil glowing faintly.
spellbook_phase_door.lore: Bilocation manual by the unknown St-Germain. The author's name still spreads slowly through the table of contents.

spellbook_turn_undead.name: Spellbook of Turn Undead
spellbook_turn_undead.sprite_desc: A  tome bound in dark leather, the cover sigil glowing faintly.
spellbook_turn_undead.lore: Vesper-prayer compendium — clerical, but the working incantation is the same one wizards use.

spellbook_meteor_swarm.name: Spellbook of Meteor Swarm
spellbook_meteor_swarm.sprite_desc: A thick tome bound in dark leather, the cover sigil glowing faintly.
spellbook_meteor_swarm.lore: Recovered from the Tunguska crater. Pages charred at edges; the central diagram is intact.

spellbook_storm_of_vengeance.name: Spellbook of Storm of Vengeance
spellbook_storm_of_vengeance.sprite_desc: A thick tome bound in dark leather, the cover sigil glowing faintly.
spellbook_storm_of_vengeance.lore: Zeus-rite copied by an Athenian heretic in 320 BCE. He was struck by lightning shortly after. The book was not.

spellbook_wish.name: Spellbook of Wish
spellbook_wish.sprite_desc: A thick tome bound in dark leather, the cover sigil glowing faintly.
spellbook_wish.lore: A single page. The page is blank. Read it anyway.

spellbook_power_word_kill.name: Spellbook of Power Word Kill
spellbook_power_word_kill.sprite_desc: A thick tome bound in dark leather, the cover sigil glowing faintly.
spellbook_power_word_kill.lore: The Vorpal Word, the cantrip the headsmen kept secret. One syllable. Several deaths.

spellbook_resurrection.name: Spellbook of Resurrection
spellbook_resurrection.sprite_desc: A thick tome bound in dark leather, the cover sigil glowing faintly.
spellbook_resurrection.lore: Lazarus liturgy — full text, with the rabbinical disclaimer that nobody who has tried it has reported their experience usefully.

spellbook_foresight.name: Spellbook of Foresight
spellbook_foresight.sprite_desc: A thick tome bound in dark leather, the cover sigil glowing faintly.
spellbook_foresight.lore: Cassandra's notes, copied centuries later by a librarian who later refused to admit knowing what was in them.

spellbook_gate.name: Spellbook of Gate
spellbook_gate.sprite_desc: A thick tome bound in dark leather, the cover sigil glowing faintly.
spellbook_gate.lore: Crowley's annotated translation of the Lemegeton gate-rite. Several entries in the index are crossed out by a different hand.

spellbook_imprisonment.name: Spellbook of Imprisonment
spellbook_imprisonment.sprite_desc: A thick tome bound in dark leather, the cover sigil glowing faintly.
spellbook_imprisonment.lore: Persian source-text on binding-into-stone — used originally against a particular djinn who was getting out of hand.

spellbook_mass_polymorph.name: Spellbook of Mass Polymorph
spellbook_mass_polymorph.sprite_desc: A thick tome bound in dark leather, the cover sigil glowing faintly.
spellbook_mass_polymorph.lore: Circe's school-notes from her time on Aeaea. Footnotes mention various species considered for the conversion.

spellbook_annihilation.name: Spellbook of Annihilation
spellbook_annihilation.sprite_desc: A thick tome bound in dark leather, the cover sigil glowing faintly.
spellbook_annihilation.lore: Final chapter of the Liber Nihili — only the final chapter survives, and reads as a list of what no longer is.
